title: Establishment of a Registry of Patients with an Extravascular Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator (EV-ICD)
summary: The aim of this project is to establish a registry for patients treated with an EV-ICD. The EV-ICD is a modern implantable device designed to protect patients from life-threatening cardiac arrhythmias. The registry will systematically collect and analyze data obtained as part of routine clinical care. These data will include, for example, information on device implantation, device function, potential complications, and the patients’ subsequent clinical course. The findings obtained from the registry will contribute to improving the care of future patients treated with an EV-ICD.

interventions.name: All patients who have received an EV-ICD at Hannover Medical School since 2023 or who will receive an EV-ICD in the future.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients with an EV-ICD or scheduled for EV-ICD implantation
2. Capacity to provide informed consent
3. Provision of patient information and written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Inability to provide informed consent
